source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιοι Χαρίσιος, Νικηφόρος και Αγάπιος»

attestations.note: The three are named on one page which then says «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο των Αγίων» — we have no details of the saints' lives. Because the line enumerates all three by name, each is kept as a folder of his own. The distich over them, «Tριάς Tριάδι νυν παρίστατ’ εν πόλω, / H των αθλητών τη τα πάντα κτισάση», counts them as three. The page gives no year, no country, no manner of death, no relic and no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).
